A [[human]] '''senator''' in the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> They were present at the [[Imperial Senate Building]] in [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|209}}</ref> when [[Senator]] [[Dasi Oran]] of [[Ghorman]] was being arrested by [[Stormtrooper]]s. At the time they had [[color|greying]] [[hair]], light skin and wore a brown and gold [[clothing|outfit]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The senator appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> Credited as "senator #7, they were portrayed by [[Michael Mears]] in the episode.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />
